package service

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/example/app/internal/handler/helper"
)

// scenario for service_calls_handler_helper: Service packages that reach upward into handler helpers for parsing, rendering, or Gin-specific utilities.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type UserService struct {
	repo UserRepository
}

func (s *UserService) GetUser(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(helper.ExtractPathParam(r, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid id: %w", err)
	}
	user, err := s.repo.FindByID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		helper.WriteJSONError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
		return err
	}
	helper.WriteJSONResponse(w, http.StatusOK, user)
	return nil
}
